verdict.rationale: Marqeta's marketing claims it lets founders 'leverage existing relationships with issuing banks, networks, and card fulfillment providers to go live in days not months' and the docs show a full program-management toolkit (card products, velocity/authorization controls, disputes, sandbox simulations, webhooks) that a founder would use instead of building bank infrastructure themselves. However, there is no concrete documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline (just the vague 'days not months' marketing line), and no explicit description of how BIN sponsorship or network membership onboarding actually works end-to-end. Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step or timeline metric from signup to live card, and explicit detail on BIN sponsor/network membership handling rather than a marketing one-liner.
